## Files

1. [`27-smoother-mixed-model.Rmd`](27-smoother-mixed-model.Rmd) / [`.R`](27-smoother-mixed-model.R) — explicit $X=[1,x]$, $Z=BU\Sigma^{-1/2}$ construction; `lme()` REML gives $\hat\sigma^2/\hat\sigma_b^2=\hat\lambda$ of `gam()`.
2. [`27-random-effects-gam.Rmd`](27-random-effects-gam.Rmd) / [`.R`](27-random-effects-gam.R) — `s(Subject, bs = "re")`, random slopes, `bs = "fs"`, `gamm4()` on `Oxboys`.
3. [`27-gamm-correlation.Rmd`](27-gamm-correlation.Rmd) / [`.R`](27-gamm-correlation.R) — the `$gam` and `$lme` components of `gamm()`, `corAR1` on daily ozone, random effects vs AR(1).

- Lab material: `R Labs/bam-statmod/Lab_07_GAMMs/` (this also replaces the former Session 31 computer lab).
- Earlier material is kept in `../extras/legacy-r-examples/`.
